veranderings.voor: Aan die ander kant moes 'n ander mens
veranderings.na: Aan die ander punt van die lyn moes iemand anders
veranderings.rede: 'Aan die ander kant' reads as the idiom 'on the other hand', and 'ander kant ... ander mens' repeats 'ander'.
'Terselfdertyd' is the natural Afrikaans form of 'at the same time'.
'Hier' is vague mid-sentence; 'So' links the conclusion to the comparison before it.

veranderings.voor: het dowe mense geleer en hy wou
veranderings.na: het dowe mense onderrig, en hy wou
veranderings.rede: 'Geleer' can read as 'learned from'; 'onderrig' is unambiguous, and the AWS comma joins two clauses with their own subject and verb.
'n Manier kry' is a calque of 'get a way'; Afrikaans finds ('vind') a way.

veranderings.voor: laat 'n dun vel vibreer wat ons 'n membraan noem
veranderings.na: laat 'n dun vel vibreer. Ons noem daardie vel 'n membraan
veranderings.rede: The relative clause 'wat ons ... noem' is separated from 'vel' by the verb and seems to refer to the vibrating; two short sentences are clearer for Grade 4.

veranderings.voor: weer klank en die ander mens hoor
veranderings.na: weer klank, en die ander mens hoor
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: in plaas van op 'n brief te wag
veranderings.na: in plaas daarvan om op 'n brief te wag
veranderings.rede: Before an infinitive clause the standard form is 'in plaas daarvan om ... te'.

veranderings.voor: in plaas van dit later te lees
veranderings.na: in plaas daarvan om dit later te lees
veranderings.rede: Same construction as the first list item: 'in plaas daarvan om ... te'.

veranderings.na: Families wat ver van mekaar gewoon het, kon
veranderings.rede: 'Families ver van mekaar' is a clipped English-style phrase; a relative clause makes it natural Afrikaans.
The comparison clause lacks its verb, so the closing 'nie' hangs; 'kan' completes it.
'Een eie draad' is awkward; 'n eie draad' is the idiomatic way to say a wire of their own.

veranderings.voor: Toe is telefoonpale opgerig en lang lyne is tussen dorpe gespan
veranderings.na: Toe is telefoonpale opgerig en lang lyne tussen dorpe gespan
veranderings.rede: The repeated 'is' is wooden; the two passives can share one auxiliary, which also needs no comma.

veranderings.voor: kon 'n mens self 'n nommer kies met 'n draaiknop op die telefoon
veranderings.na: kon 'n mens self met 'n draaiknop op die telefoon 'n nommer kies
veranderings.rede: In Afrikaans the infinitive goes at the end; the prepositional phrase belongs before 'n nommer kies'.

veranderings.voor: het drukknoppies in die plek van die draaiknop gekom
veranderings.na: het drukknoppies die plek van die draaiknop ingeneem
veranderings.rede: 'Die plek van iets inneem' is the natural idiom for replacing something.

veranderings.voor: Toe kom die selfoon en die draad
veranderings.na: Toe het die selfoon gekom, en die draad
veranderings.rede: Two clauses with their own subject and verb need the AWS comma, and the tense now matches 'het weggeval'.

vlae.teks: Die telefoon dra jou stem self oor die draad na die ander mens.
vlae.rede: This may read as the wire carrying the voice itself, while the block 'Hoe 'n telefoon jou stem oordra' says the wire carries signals, not sound; not changed because fixing it means choosing content.
